name: First Cut
teaches: Scrapping is not failure. It is the only permanent output bonus in a run.

name: Chain Reaction
teaches: A Trigger that fires on your own output makes a loop. That is the whole game.

name: Depth Six
teaches: Depth costs more and pays less each step. Going deeper is a choice you fund.

name: Bottomless
teaches: The depth cap exists so a loop terminates, not so you never reach it.

name: Self-Sustaining
hint: Keep firing for 10s with no Clock row live.
teaches: An Engine that feeds itself needs no metronome. It needs a first hit.

name: Surfing
hint: Hold Instability I for 45s without an Overheat.
teaches: Instability is a place to live, not a doorway. Running hot is a strategy.

name: Deep Water
hint: Hold Instability II for 20s without an Overheat.
teaches: Tier II corrupts your own fire. The damage in the post-mortem is yours.

name: Controlled Burn
hint: Fire an Action from an On Overheat trigger.
teaches: The penalty system is a trigger. Weaponising it is intended.

name: Arbitrage
teaches: Fuel is not only ammunition. It is a currency with three exchange rates.

name: Full Tanks
hint: Hold all three fuel gauges above 70 at once.
teaches: A full gauge is fuel nothing you own can spend. Diversify or convert.

name: Siphoned
hint: Reach 60 fuel in a hue while its resistance is above 30%.
teaches: Overusing one hue taxes it. The world adapts to your build.

name: Flank It
teaches: The shield arc is drawn for a reason. Positioning beats raw output.

name: Blackout
hint: Kill a Suppressor while standing inside its zone.
teaches: Inside the zone your Triggers are dead. Actions already in flight are not.

name: Untouchable
hint: Survive the first 3 minutes without taking damage.
teaches: Integrity is a resource you spend, not a bar you protect. But you can refuse.

name: Swarmed
teaches: The director never stops. Clearing the screen is not the win condition.

name: Prestige
teaches: Burning a working Engine buys a permanent multiplier. Timing is the skill.

name: Divergence
teaches: Past twenty minutes the score multiplier climbs without limit, and so does the pressure.

name: Double or Nothing
hint: Reach a Meltdown multiplier of x2.00.
teaches: Every 30s of divergence is worth more than the minute before it.

name: Contained
hint: End a run inside Meltdown rather than before it.
teaches: There is no winning. There is only how far you took it.

name: Beacon Runner
teaches: Standing still is the price. Everything good in this game costs position.

name: Wide Load
teaches: Every live row reserves Cycles forever, whether it fires or not.

name: Overtuned
hint: Have one Program produce 90% of your output, with 3 or more live.
teaches: A carry row is efficient and fragile. Pressure systems attack the build.

name: Critical Mass
teaches: On Crit is a real trigger once you have fed it Precision.

name: Volatile Thinking
teaches: Events per second is the score. Everything else is a means to it.

name: Bloodletting
hint: Convert Integrity into fuel while below 40 Integrity.
teaches: Health is convertible. The engine does not care whether you survive it.
